profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Coinbase | 4x Hackathon Winner

positions.title: Technical Lead & Co-founder of ZotNFound.com
positions.description:
• Led the team of 9 in developing a web app to help UCI students locate and recover lost belongings.
• Attracted 300+ Instagram followers, 5K+ page views, 100+ sign-up users, and helped 10+ people in the first 6 weeks of launch.
• Developed a web application with React and a mobile app compatible with both Android and iOS using React Native and TypeScript.
• Led migration to serverless microservice architecture with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: • Led a 12-developer team for Orange County's nonprofit, Stand Up To Trash, using Scrum; facilitated weekly standups, sprint planning, crafted project requirements documentation, and conducted code reviews.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description: • Volunteered with a 15-person team to develop a donation management tool for NPO Patriots and Paws Anaheim, enhancing furniture donation coordination using React, PostgreSQL, NodeJS, and Express.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Wasteless
• Built a website to visualize places to reuse and recycle goods in Orange County.
• Contributed as a frontend developer, developed the web application using ReactJS, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JS, Figma.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Coding Instructor
positions.description:
• Fostered the next generation of programmers by leading Python, C++, HTML/CSS courses for students grades 1-10.
• Devised personalized lesson plans tailored to students' progress and needs to increase comprehension and proficiency.

positions.title: Learning Assistance
positions.description:
ICS 46 - Data Structure Implementation and Analysis

positions.title: Lab Tutor
positions.description:
ICS 31 - Introduction to Programming in Python
• Provided academic support to a group of 40 students by offering feedback and guidance on assignments and projects
• Demonstrated consistent attendance and a strong work ethic by reliably attending assigned labs and working alongside a TA three times a week. 
• Proactively arrived early to assist with exam preparation and remained after class to offer additional support to students.
